title: Create P0 Vitest-based test suite for BOM Determinism, Transaction Atomicity, and Finalization Concurrency
description: Create a P0 test suite covering BOM determinism (same input = same output), transaction atomicity (failures produce 0 lines), and finalization concurrency (double-submit guards, state transitions).
acceptance_criteria: All three test files are syntactically correct TypeScript
Tests follow existing patterns from bomPipeline.test.ts and finalizationStore.test.ts
BOM determinism tests verify 10x repeated calls produce identical output with SHA-256 hash verification
Transaction atomicity tests verify blocking errors produce 0 BOM lines
Finalization concurrency tests verify double-submit guards and state transitions
findings: node_modules not installed in sandbox - TypeScript compilation cannot be verified but test files follow exact patterns from existing passing tests
Used heredoc (bash cat) for file creation since fs_write did not persist to the file system
Tests use vi.mock with importOriginal pattern to allow real pipeline execution in pipeline-level tests while enabling mock overrides in store-level tests
The mockRpc variable must be declared before vi.mock in finalizationConcurrency.test.ts due to vitest hoisting semantics
